entries.text: A mob came for {npcname} with torches; the building paid, {f:condition}
Hellfire rose through the floor one night, leaving it {f:condition}
A paladin died defending its door; it bears the memory, {f:condition}
A hag lodged there one summer and left it odd, {f:condition}
The forest reached for it and took what it could, {f:condition}
Pack ice crushed against it one winter, leaving it {f:condition}
Drow raiders came up through the cellars; it survived, {f:condition}
Its wards failed one midnight, and it has flickered since, {f:condition}
Then {npcname} locked the doors from inside, and it was left {f:condition}
A war rolled over it, and it came through, {f:condition}
Owners came and went, and it outlasted every one, {f:condition}
{npcname}'s heirs sued over it for forty years; it endured, {f:condition}
The trouble began with {its:feature}. It was never the same after, {f:condition}
Every owner after {npcname} died there, and the place looks it, {f:condition}
Plague came; they nailed the doors shut and forgot it, {f:condition}
A devil collected on the deed, and left it marked, {f:condition}
An angel judged {npcname}, and the building bore the verdict, {f:condition}
It spent one night in the Feywild and returned changed, {f:condition}
{npcname} was buried under the floor; it has not slept since, {f:condition}
The great storm came, and it rode out the night, {f:condition}
Something climbed up from below and nested in it, {f:condition}
{npcname}'s final experiment went wrong, and it took the blast, {f:condition}
A great beast denned there one winter, and it shows, {f:condition}
Snow buried it for ten years; the thaw found it {f:condition}
Fire took it one summer night, and it rose again, {f:condition}
A dragon besieged it for a season, and it held, {f:condition}
A portal tore open in the cellar and half-swallowed it, {f:condition}
